The following events took place in '''3660 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Succeeding where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] have [[Battle near Devaron|failed]],<ref name="Timeline3">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians|int=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians}}</ref> a smuggler convoy [[Battle on the Hydian Way|broke]] the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]] and restored the Republic's trade route.<ref name="Timeline2" />
*[[Mandalore the Vindicated|Artus Lok]] won the [[Great Hunt (c. 3660 BBY)|Great Hunt]], then killed [[Mandalore the Lesser]] and claimed the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] as Mandalore the Vindicated.<ref name="TOR:TMS">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Galactic History 93: The Mandalorian Schism}}</ref><ref name="Mandalore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' and the "[[The Holonet|Holonet]]" section of its official website placed the [[Great Hunt (c. 3660 BBY)|Great Hunt]] won by [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] between the [[battle on the Hydian Way]] and the [[Crusader's schism]]. As these two events are respectively dated to 3660 BBY and c. 3660 BBY, the Great Hunt and the subsequent death of [[Mandalore the Lesser]] can be placed around 3660 BBY as well.</ref>
